title: Silent Night was first sung in an Austrian church on Christmas Eve 1818. Which instrument played along?
alt: The covers of the UK and American editions of The Don't Die Retired Christmas Quiz Book, beside the words: Silent Night was first sung in an Austrian church on Christmas Eve 1818. Which instrument played along?

posts.facebook:
Silent Night was first sung in an Austrian church on Christmas Eve 1818. Which instrument played along?

The answer is further down ↓

·
·
·

Answer: A guitar. Not the organ: it was written for two voices and guitar. There is a famous story that the organ was broken, but there is no evidence for it.

It's one of the 300 questions in our Christmas Quiz Book, in a UK and an American edition, on Amazon.
